C_depth_and_siblings_disagree.can_fail_because: depth and sibling count rank the three key sets in the same order, which would make depth a valid proxy and retract nothing
C_depth_and_siblings_disagree.must_fire_because: S75 and S76 both converted depth into proof size by multiplication; that is only valid if the two quantities order the key sets the same way
C_depth_and_siblings_disagree.name: C_depth_and_siblings_disagree
C_depth_and_siblings_disagree.null_must_contain: three key sets spanning 12 to 1,155 byte keys and 10.3 to 139.1 node depth, which is ample room for the two orderings to AGREE and for this control to come out negative

C_every_sampled_proof_verifies.can_fail_because: any sampled membership proof fails verify_membership against the root hash
C_every_sampled_proof_verifies.must_fire_because: a proof whose verifier rejects is not a proof and its size is a number about nothing -- W1 shipped four controls with no verification function at all
C_every_sampled_proof_verifies.name: C_every_sampled_proof_verifies
C_every_sampled_proof_verifies.null_must_contain: a verifier that returns False, which W2 has and W1 did not

C_long_keys_add_nodes_not_branches.can_fail_because: the longest-key set does not have the fewest siblings per node on its path
C_long_keys_add_nodes_not_branches.must_fire_because: the reason depth fails as a proxy: the extra nodes a 1,155-byte key contributes are single-child and carry no digests
C_long_keys_add_nodes_not_branches.name: C_long_keys_add_nodes_not_branches
C_long_keys_add_nodes_not_branches.null_must_contain: the original atom keys, whose 139.1 mean depth gives them ample room to ALSO carry the most siblings if long runs were branchy

C_probe_reads_the_zipper_correctly.can_fail_because: the two-key self-check reports any sibling count other than 1
C_probe_reads_the_zipper_correctly.must_fire_because: a misread of child_count would produce a confident sibling count about nothing, and it is the only quantity this spike measures
C_probe_reads_the_zipper_correctly.name: C_probe_reads_the_zipper_correctly
C_probe_reads_the_zipper_correctly.null_must_contain: a hand-decidable trie: keys "aa" and "ab" branch exactly once, so the path to "aa" has exactly 1 sibling and any other answer is a misreading

C_real_prover_agrees_with_the_sibling_wa.can_fail_because: W2 real proof bytes rank the three key sets differently from the pathmap sibling walk
C_real_prover_agrees_with_the_sibling_wa.must_fire_because: sibling count times 32 B is arithmetic; a prover that exists and a verifier that accepts are the check on it
C_real_prover_agrees_with_the_sibling_wa.name: C_real_prover_agrees_with_the_sibling_walk
C_real_prover_agrees_with_the_sibling_wa.null_must_contain: W2's own proof sizes on the same keys, produced by a prover written before this spike and free to rank the sets any way at all

C_same_key_files_as_S75_S76.can_fail_because: any key count differs from the count in the reviewed spike's compare.json
C_same_key_files_as_S75_S76.must_fire_because: this is a review of two specific spikes, so it has to run on their committed key files rather than on re-derived ones
C_same_key_files_as_S75_S76.name: C_same_key_files_as_S75_S76
C_same_key_files_as_S75_S76.null_must_contain: the key counts S75 and S76 recorded (1,246 atoms, 4,096 triples), which this spike does not compute and cannot adjust

retracts.S75: the ~33 KB figure for S73 isolated insert proofs on real pathmap
retracts.S76: the ~14 KB (id4) and ~9.9 KB (id2) figures, which inherit it
retracts.ground: depth was multiplied by a digest width; the quantity that buys digests is siblings on the path, and long keys add nodes without adding siblings
